title: Bragulla et al. 2026 — purified N2 gas washing, nondetect kept as an interval
description: N2 5.0 passed through an Agilent OT3-4 in-line purifier at 10 mL/min for 64.32 h (38.57 L) through 50 mL of 0.2 M H2SO4 gave ammonium below the method limit of detection. NitroTrace keeps the nondetect as the interval [0, MLOD] rather than zero. The authors' '<3 ppb_mol' statement is reproduced as the delivered-gas bound.

evidence.quote: The method limit of detection (MLOD) calculated from this calibration function was 1.8 µg L−1 ammonium (Figure 4)
evidence.note: The article also states an MLOD of 2 µg/L (abstract) and 5.4 µg/L (§4). The §3.3 calibration value (1.8 µg/L) is used; with 5.4 µg/L the upper bound would be 3× larger. 64.32 h = 3859.2 min.

evidence.quote: The nevertheless calculated remaining ammonia contamination is below 3 ppbmol.
evidence.note: Derived from the nondetect; NOx not measured.

evidence.quote: Agilent OT3‐4 [5], 10 mL min−1, 64.32 h, 38.57 L total, 0.2 M H2SO4, 50 mL, 3 ppbmol, <0.05 pmol s−1.
evidence.note: Temperature and pressure of the 38.57 L are not stated; 298.15 K and 101325 Pa are ASSUMED.

assumptions: Gas volume 38.57 L taken at an assumed 298.15 K and 101325 Pa (not stated in the source).
Nondetect represented as [0, 1.8 µg/L] NH4+ in 50 mL.
